corrections.reason: The verb split across L27-L28 is 'ያረክሱ' (3rd person masculine plural imperfective of አርኰሰ/አርከሰ). Visually on L28 the first glyph is 6th-order 'ክ' (ክሱ), not 2nd-order 'ኩ'.
The printed glyph at the start of 'ጸባሕት' (tribute/tax) is the three-legged 'ጸ', not 'ፀ'.
The printed text uses 'ሣ' (ንጉሥ ሣ) in 'መነሣት', matching the Ge'ez root ተንሥአ / ትንሣኤ.
The printed word is the standard 3-character Amharic plural 'ጻፎች' (scribes, translating ጸሐፍት), not 'ጻፈዎች'.
